sentences: Otto did not bring the first-aid kit.
contradictions.explanation: These two statements directly contradict each other regarding whether Otto brought the first-aid kit.

sentences: Otto, who had arrived last, jogged to catch up with the others, his boots squelching in the mud.
Ivo arrived a few minutes before Uma, both carrying binoculars slung around their necks, while Dara showed up shortly after with a battered field guide tucked under one arm.
contradictions.explanation: If Otto arrived last, but only Ivo, Uma, and Dara's arrival order is given without Otto, the statement that Otto arrived last is inconsistent since Otto is also said to have arrived after checking gear at the gate implying earlier presence, creating an ordering conflict with him jogging to catch up implying lateness while also being present with the group earlier.

sentences: Ivo and Uma were on different teams.
Uma and Dara were on different teams.
Ivo and Dara were on different teams.
contradictions.explanation: With three teams and Ivo, Uma, and Dara all pairwise on different teams, this uses all three teams for these three people, but this is mathematically consistent so on its own not contradictory; however combined with Pia and Otto needing team assignments among only three teams, it becomes impossible to avoid forcing at least two of the five people including Pia or Otto onto the same team as one of the three without contradicting the constraint that would be implied if a fourth distinct team were required.
